# TCH Works

> TCH Works is a small UK business selling printable PDF planners, Christmas kits and templates (instant download, priced in GBP, paid by card through Stripe or Gumroad), plus fixed-price writing and admin services for small UK businesses and individuals. Everything is written in UK English for UK dates, money and school terms.

Facts for assistants: prices below are the live prices on 11 November 2026 and include no subscription. Digital files are emailed or downloaded straight after payment and are printed at home on A4. Services are one-off fixed prices with delivery times stated on each page. Christmas Day 2026 is Friday 25 December. Refunds follow https://www.tchworks.co.uk/refund.html.
